facts: Native text/image/video inputs are fused before the text backbone; text output.
Text hidden size 6144; 60 decoder layers; all 60 use MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA). Layers 0–2 use dense FFN; layers 3–59 use MoE.

Pre-normalized decoder: x enters Norm then attention; attention output is added to x. The resulting hidden state enters Norm then FFN/MoE; FFN output is added to the pre-FFN hidden state. Final norm and LM head lie after the decoder stack.
64 query heads, 4 KV heads, head dimension128: 4 GQA groups, 16 Q heads per group. No attention output gate.

Indexer has 4 query heads (one/group), width128, and shared index key. Scaled token dot scores are reduced by maximum within each 128-token block; each group selects Top16 blocks, including the local block within the 16-block budget.

Indexer considers causal j<=i, fully future blocks score minus infinity. Main attention uses exact content QK softmax V on the selected group KV with causal masking within all selected blocks, including the local block. Main K/V are group-specific; shared index K is distinct from main K.

128 routed experts, Top4, one shared expert. Token data feeds router, selected experts, shared expert. Router computes sigmoid scores; correction bias affects selection only. Selected original unbiased scores are renormalized as mixing weights, and routed sum is scaled by2. Shared expert output is then added; shared does not pass through routed mixing/renorm.
Router intermediate expert size3072. Only parameter annotations that aid understanding are required.
DSpark is an auxiliary draft, not extra decoder layers. Omit its internals in this scope.
